name: Cherry Studio
tagline: Desktop client for multiple AI models supporting DeepSeek, Claude, and GPT
description: Cherry Studio is an open-source desktop AI client supporting multiple LLM providers (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Ollama) with knowledge bases, prompt templates, and conversation branch management.
features: Direct integration with DeepSeek-R1, OpenAI, Claude 3.5, and local Ollama
Local document knowledge base with vector search
Conversation branching and side-by-side model comparison
Multi-language translation and code execution blocks
